name: cc200_site_holdout_v1
rationale: Hold out entire acquisition sites. NeuroIMAGE is validation and Peking_2 is final test; each contains both labels and roughly balanced classes. Keep all subjects from a site in one partition. OHSU and Pittsburgh are control-only in this extracted cohort and remain in train.

preprocessing.fit_scope: training partition or training fold only

steps.name: median_imputation
steps.note: No missing values were observed in the current feature matrix; step is retained for fold-local robustness.

steps.name: univariate_selection
steps.note: Initial conservative setting only; fit within each training fold. Consider tuning k in nested CV later.

preprocessing.selection_reason: k=100 is retained as an initial conservative reduction for p=19,900 and n_train=114; evaluate alternatives and stability only within training-only CV.
